opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance, with at least one year's worth of annual accounts. Not individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for UK charities, open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Covers operating/core costs, capital projects, and specific projects/activities. Typically supports around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget (or capital/project costs).

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations. For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million (organisation income need not exceed £1 million).
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via an Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) typically capped at £30,000 and advised to apply for a Regular Grant.
